bloodmagic:divinationsigil.t: The Divination Sigil is probably the first of many sigils that you would like to craft in Blood Magic. In order to craft the sigil, you need to create an Alchemy Array and use Redstone Dust and a Blank Slate as the base and catalyst items, respectively. Peer into the soul.

minecraft:elytra.t: Adds an Elytra to your Living Armor. Rather than being trained, the Upgrade Tome must be crafted. This Elytra does drain durability from the Chestplate, but at half the speed of a normal Elytra.

bloodmagic:livingleggings.t: To create Living Equipment, you will first need Iron Armor (or Iron Armour, if you prefer), some Arcane Ash, and some Binding Reagent. You'll also need at least a Common Tartaric Gem in order to hold the Demon Will required. It clings to me tightly...

bloodmagic:livinghelmet.t: Living Armor adapts to your magical practices. When practicing Ars Nouveau's glyph-based magic, your armor learns and evolves, unlocking the Source Attunement upgrade path designed specifically for source-wielding mages.

bloodmagic:livingplate.t: To create Living Equipment, you will first need Iron Armor (or Iron Armour, if you prefer), some Arcane Ash, and some Binding Reagent. You'll also need at least a Common Tartaric Gem in order to hold the Demon Will required. It clings to me tightly...

bloodmagic:livingboots.t: To create Living Equipment, you will first need Iron Armor (or Iron Armour, if you prefer), some Arcane Ash, and some Binding Reagent. You'll also need at least a Common Tartaric Gem in order to hold the Demon Will required. It clings to me tightly...

bloodmagic:upgradetrainer.t: This new equipment is an incredible help, but its undirected growth can sometimes be... frustrating. To this end, you have devised a form of Training Bracelet to assist you in your endeavours.

bloodmagic:growthsigil.t: The Sigil of the Green Grove is an item that has multiple uses. Crafted in an array with a Growth Reagent and a Reinforced Slate, the sigil can use your Soul Network's LP to nourish and grow nearby plants. The Sigil of the Green Grove's array, plus its primary uses.

bloodmagic:icesigil.t: you've heard tell of ancient boots enchanted with Frost-walking, freezing the ground and water beneath the wearer's feet. That sounds like fine inspiration for a sigil! It's even able to be toggled, so you're not in danger of freezing over your farmlands every time you get close.

bloodmagic:sigilofmagnetism.t: Increases the player's item pickup range to 7 blocks when active. Toggle on/off by holding the Sigil in your hand, and then holding the Sneak key and pressing the Use key. Consumes 50 LP every 5 seconds while active.

bloodmagic:miningsigil.t: The Sigil of the Fast Miner is a Sigil that, when activated using the Sneak key and the Use key, will consume 100 LP every 5 seconds and apply the Haste potion effect. Thus, it increases your mining, digging, and cutting speeds.

bloodmagic:seersigil.t: The Seer's Sigil is a more advanced form of the Divination Sigil. Alongside showing the amount of LP in the bound player's Soul Network, it also shows more information when looking at a Blood Altar. Like the Divination Sigil, it can also be used to edit your GUI.

bloodmagic:sigilofsuppression.t: The Sigil of Suppression, when activated via pressing the Use key, will temporarily obliviate all fluids in a roughly 6-block radius of its holder. A short while after moving away from the liquid in question, it will return as though it never left.

bloodmagic:soulsword.t: The Sentient Sword is a much more effective tool for collecting Demon Will than Soul Snares could ever hope to be. It may seem weak at first, but it is powered by the Wills you carry, so crafting a Tartaric Gem is a must.

bloodmagic:soulgemgreater.t: Demon Will is a very useful resource, but the fragments you have been getting so far are decidedly lacking in power. What you need is a storage item; A Tartaric Gem seems just the thing. What's more, it can absorb any leftover Demon Will you might have lying around.

bloodmagic:experiencebook.t: The Tome of Peritia allows you to safely store your experience. pressing the Sneak key and the Use key with the Tome in hand stores one level of XP. Pressing the Use key retrieves a level.

enigmaticlegacy:desolation_ring.t: You can scarce comprehend presence imposed upon reality by Heart of the Abyss, but, as you have recently discovered, comprehension is not necessary for the ability to make use of it.

enigmaticlegacy:enchanter_pearl.t: Among many ways you can harness the power of Wither's soul, there is this truly precious pearl, capable of breaking the limits you usually have to cope with when working with Enchanting Table.

enigmaticlegacy:golden_ring.t: A bit more work and about as much of precious gold, and you can reforge mundane iron ring into much shinier and fancier form.

enigmaticlegacy:insignia.t: Although this little trinket will not afford you increased strength, speed or will - there is more to it than appears at first glance. It allows you to conceal your name in the eyes of other demigods, and replace it with the one of your liking.

enigmaticlegacy:iron_ring.t: Quite simple in its design, this thing could've been forged even by the most casual blacksmith, not to mention a demigod alike you. This ring is only useful as all it takes to create is some mundane iron.

enigmaticlegacy:magnet_ring.t: Despite simplicity of its design, Magnetic Ring already holds some arcane power.

enigmaticlegacy:monster_charm.t: Sometimes those monsters mindlessly wandering in the dark can become great annoyance. Now that you hold power to forge Netherite, more often than not they're reduced from once considerable threat to a slight inconvenience staining your blade.

enigmaticlegacy:super_magnet_ring.t: A long anticipated upgrade of Magnetic Ring, the Ring of Dislocation is better in every way. Infused with fraction of mystical energy of The End, it covers area twice as large as its predecessor, and instead of drawing dropped items towards you, it... draws you towards items.

enigmaticlegacy:angel_blessing.t: This spellstone can be found within ruins of ancient temples, those that served purpose you know not.

enigmaticlegacy:ascension_amulet.t: By now, you are aware that Enigmatic Amulet in your possession is not unique, and in fact such a thing is granted to many other demigods beyond your time and space. There seems to exist a few variations of it, with different colors and different powers.

enigmaticlegacy:blazing_core.t: Among the blazing wastes and seething oceans of lava stretching over blasted reaches of the Nether, among the cries of souls torn apart and forgotten, and ashes that any attempt to lay claim and rule over these wastes were reduced to, there's no surprise to come across the spellstone that embod…

enigmaticlegacy:enigmatic_amulet.t: When you first stepped into this world, you discovered this thing conveniently lying in your pockets, with no clues to where it came from, nor why it ended up in your possession.

enigmaticlegacy:enigmatic_item.t: Powers of this stone are so vast and overwhelming, that they appear to have never been intended to be possessed by a demigod. It grants you ultimate protection from most environmental threats.

enigmaticlegacy:eye_of_nebula.t: Found among strange, enigmatic lands of The End, this spellstone is overfilled with enderic energies, associated with traits of dimension itself.

enigmaticlegacy:astral_breaker.t: Classical etherium tools are quite potent and useful on their own, but they are not the limit of what can be forged with all power of this metal.

enigmaticlegacy:eldritch_pan.t: The very bones of the universe, both celestial and eldritch, lay at your fingertips. And yet, you still crave more... Fortunately, the unthinkable nature of Heart of the Abyss can be employed in this pursuit of yours.

enigmaticlegacy:ender_slayer.t: One of the toughest lessons you have learned ever since first equipping Ring of the Seven Curses is that Endermen are no longer able to tolerate your existence.

enigmaticlegacy:etherium_axe.t: Unlike normal axes, this massive beast is designed to serve as tool and weapon at the same time, excelling as both. When using it as tool, it can chop down wood in massive space of 3x3x3 blocks, centered around the point of impact.

goety_revelation:broken_halo.t: When the apostles are perishing, there will always be a strange energy fluctuation spreading out. This makes you, a dark sorcerer, usually curious. You usually wonder if you can capture that strange fluctuation.

goety_revelation:eternal_watch.t: After obtaining the eternal item, you managed to conduct some tests on it and understood its essence. After several attempts, you finally understood how to fully exert its function.

goety_revelation:gold_feather.t: We become extremely vulnerable when casting spells, as they cannot move freely. Unless you have a mount, you must endure the agonizingly slow crawl during the casting time. Fortunately, you've learned a technique from the villagers that allows limited movement during spellcasting!

goety_revelation:spectre_boots.t: Sometimes you wonder—how do those blue specters truly manifest? After countless experiments, you fused ectoplasm with echoes of the damned, forging Specter Armor. The Specter helmet remains unaffected by blindness, while the boots grant absolute silence to your movements.

goety_revelation:spectre_chestplate.t: Sometimes you wonder—how do those blue specters truly manifest? After countless experiments, you fused ectoplasm with echoes of the damned, forging Specter Armor. The Specter helmet remains unaffected by blindness, while the boots grant absolute silence to your movements.

goety_revelation:spectre_leggings.t: Sometimes you wonder—how do those blue specters truly manifest? After countless experiments, you fused ectoplasm with echoes of the damned, forging Specter Armor. The Specter helmet remains unaffected by blindness, while the boots grant absolute silence to your movements.

goety_revelation:spectre_helmet.t: Sometimes you wonder—how do those blue specters truly manifest? After countless experiments, you fused ectoplasm with echoes of the damned, forging Specter Armor. The Specter helmet remains unaffected by blindness, while the boots grant absolute silence to your movements.

goety_revelation:spider_boots.t: Spiders are terrifying creatures, yet we can learn much from them.That's why you crafted specialized armor—one that makes you more... spider-like?! The Spider boots protect you from fall damage, while the helmet grants night vision, revealing all even in utter darkness.

goety_revelation:spider_helmet.t: Spiders are terrifying creatures, yet we can learn much from them.That's why you crafted specialized armor—one that makes you more... spider-like?! The Spider boots protect you from fall damage, while the helmet grants night vision, revealing all even in utter darkness.

The Spider boots protect you from fall damage, while the helmet grants night vision, revealing all even in utter darkness.

naturesaura:aura_cache.t: Having a Natural Altar around that stores Aura is all well and good, but it would be more convenient to be able to carry it around. In that case, the Aura Cache will prove useful: It stores a substantial amount of Aura in it so one can use it on the go.

naturesaura:death_ring.t: When one is stuck, as one says, between a rock and a hard place, not much can be done - sometimes, death just has to be accepted as an occurence.

naturesaura:depth_pants.t: When wearing Soulstrider's armor, a magical botanist can feel dark energy surging in them.

naturesaura:depth_helmet.t: When wearing Soulstrider's armor, a magical botanist can feel dark energy surging in them.

naturesaura:eye.t: When working with Aura, by nature, it will be hard to grasp just how much there is in any given area or storage device.

naturesaura:eye_improved.t: The Environmental Eye is very useful in theory; however, a lot of magical botanists struggle with its limited range of gauging Aura in the environment around them. A simple solution to this problem is the Environmental Ocular.

naturesaura:shockwave_creator.t: The Amulet of Wrath, when held anywhere in the inventory, allows its wearer to focus their power, giving them the ability to, when sneaking and jumping in place, stomp down on the ground hard enough to create a shockwave that hurts any other living creatures close by.

naturesaura:sky_helmet.t: Botanists may feel like the Gods when wearing Skyseeker's armor. Not only can it be repaired like its infused counterpart, it also provides a set bonus: When wearing every piece of the armor (or swapping the chestplate for an Elytra), the wearer's movement speed will be increased.

naturesaura:sky_pants.t: Botanists may feel like the Gods when wearing Skyseeker's armor. Not only can it be repaired like its infused counterpart, it also provides a set bonus: When wearing every piece of the armor (or swapping the chestplate for an Elytra), the wearer's movement speed will be increased.

justdirethings:blazegold_boots.t: Blazegold Boots provide enhanced foot protection and come with the Lava Repair ability. To fully repair these boots, drop them into a lava source block.

justdirethings:blazegold_chestplate.t: The Blazegold Chestplate not only provides enhanced defense but also features the Lava Repair ability. Drop this chestplate into a lava source block to fully repair it.

justdirethings:blazegold_helmet.t: The Blazegold Helmet offers superior protection compared to its Ferricore predecessor, enhanced with the unique Lava Repair ability. Drop this item into a lava source block to fully repair it.

justdirethings:blazegold_leggings.t: Blazegold Leggings offer superior mobility and protection. Utilize the Lava Repair ability by dropping these leggings into a lava source block for full repair.

justdirethings:celestigem_chestplate.t: The Celestigem Chestplate uses Forge Energy for its functionality, equipped with a 10,000 FE capacity. It's ideal to use a Pocket Generator for keeping it continuously charged.

justdirethings:eclipsealloy_leggings.t: Crafted for ultimate endurance, these leggings are powered by 500,000 FE of Forge Energy. Use a Pocket Generator to maintain their power levels and functionality.

justdirethings:ferricore_boots.t: The Ferricore Boots are crafted for adventurers, providing slightly more protection and durability than iron boots. They can be upgraded to offer enhanced abilities like increased jumping.

justdirethings:ferricore_leggings.t: Designed for both comfort and protection, Ferricore Leggings provide enhanced durability and the option for further upgrades to increase your movement speed.

justdirethings:blazegold_sword.t: Enhanced damage over the Ferricore Sword. Features 'Lava Repair' for full repair when dropped into lava.

justdirethings:bow_celestigem.t: The Celestigem Bow surpasses Blazegold Bow, utilizing Forge Energy instead of durability. It can hold up to 10,000 FE, ideal for long use without wear. This bow features 3 'Potion Canister slots', allowing for customized effects.

justdirethings:celestigem_sword.t: An upgrade to Blazegold Sword, this sword uses Forge Energy instead of durability. It holds 10,000 FE, best kept charged with a Pocket Generator.

justdirethings:eclipsealloy_axe.t: This Eclipse Alloy Axe excels in woodcutting with high efficiency and increased energy storage. It's engineered for enduring the most demanding lumber tasks.

justdirethings:bow_eclipsealloy.t: The Eclipse Alloy Bow embodies the ultimate in ranged weaponry, providing vast energy reserves for prolonged use. It features 4 slots for Potion Canisters, enhancing arrows with various effects.

justdirethings:ferricore_axe.t: The Ferricore Axe is not only efficient at chopping wood but also effective as a weapon. It surpasses the iron axe in both durability and cutting speed and can be further enhanced with upgrades.

justdirethings:bow_ferricore.t: The Ferricore Bow, crafted from robust Ferricore, enhances standard bow functionalities with increased durability and the ability to be upgraded with various abilities.

justdirethings:ferricore_sword.t: The Ferricore Sword is a robust melee weapon slightly superior to traditional iron swords. Crafted from Ferricore, it not only provides enhanced damage but also offers the potential for further upgrades with special abilities, enhancing its utility in combat scenarios.

adamsarsplus:adam_hood.t: Taking your Ascendant mage armor you've discovered how to augment it with the elemental void souls you've obtained to push your magecraft to a level beyond what should be possible.

adamsarsplus:cade_hood.t: Taking your Tier 3 mage armor you've discovered how to augment it with the elemental frost souls you've obtained to push your magecraft to an elite level.

adamsarsplus:camr_hood.t: Taking your Elemental mage armor you've discovered how to augment it with the elemental lightning souls you've obtained to push your magecraft to an ascendant level.

adamsarsplus:enchanters_stopwatch.t: A charm that repeatedly casts spells on a defined interval. The spell can be set using a scribes table. Holding the charm and using it in the main/offhand can increase/decrease the casting interval.

adamsarsplus:generals_wheel.t: A charm that causes summoning sickness to be removed at a faster rate. The rate of reduction is increased by how many of the ten shadows are under the wearers control. At max this charm provides a 50 percent reduction in summoning sickness duration.

adamsarsplus:matt_hood.t: Taking your Elemental mage armor you've discovered how to augment it with the elemental ancient souls you've obtained to push your magecraft to an ascendant level.

adamsarsplus:nick_hood.t: Taking your Tier 3 mage armor you've discovered how to augment it with the elemental earth souls you've obtained to push your magecraft to an elite level.

adamsarsplus:ryan_hood.t: Taking your Tier 3 mage armor you've discovered how to augment it with the elemental flame souls you've obtained to push your magecraft to an elite level.

animus:blood_infused_spellbook.t: The Blood-Infused Spellbook combines the power of Iron's Spells with Blood Magic's sacrificial arts. This unique tome can be progressively enhanced through six tiers of blood infusion, each granting powerful new abilities.

animus:key_binding.t: The Key of Binding is a mystical key bound to a blood mage's Soul Network. Its primary purpose is to share your LP with friends - give a bound key to an ally and they can bind their items to YOUR Soul Network, drawing from your LP reserves.

animus:spear_diamond.t: Roman-style throwable javelins. Hold right-click to charge, then release to throw. When thrown, spears deal AOE damage where they land.

animus:spear_iron.t: Roman-style throwable javelins. Hold right-click to charge, then release to throw. When thrown, spears deal AOE damage where they land.

animus:spear_bound.t: Roman-style throwable javelins. Hold right-click to charge, then release to throw. When thrown, spears deal AOE damage where they land.

create:goggles.t: Ars Creo enables special contraption behaviors for blocks from Ars Nouveau, including Spell Turrets and Source Jars. Basic Spell Turret - Fires a spell on contraption when interacted. Timer Turret - Fires a spell on its interval.

ars_elemental:air_focus.t: This spell focus is attuned to the school of Air. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified and discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other elemental schools.

ars_elemental:earth_bangle.t: This bangle will boost the damage of your Earth spells. Plants blossom on your arms, inflicting snare to enemies hit and granting the wearer immunity to cactus and berry bushes and knockback resistance.

ars_elemental:earth_focus.t: This spell focus is attuned to the school of Earth. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified and discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other elemental schools.

ars_elemental:fire_bangle.t: This bangle will boost the damage of your Fire spells. Your arms are engulfed in the element, setting on fire enemies hit and granting a passive boost to speed while in hot biomes.

ars_elemental:fire_focus.t: This spell focus is attuned to the school of Fire. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified and discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other elemental schools.

ars_elemental:summon_bangle.t: This bangle will boost the damage of your Summoning spells. Your summons follows your arms movement, targeting whatever your hit with increased damage.

ars_elemental:water_bangle.t: This bangle will boost the damage of your Water spells. Your arms chills the air around, freezing enemies on every hit. It will also grant the wearer a passive boost to speed in water and rain.

ars_elemental:water_focus.t: This spell focus is attuned to the school of Water. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified and discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other elemental schools.

ars_nouveau:alchemists_crown.t: Allows the wearer to consume potions and flasks instantly from their inventory.

ars_nouveau:amulet_of_mana_boost.t: Increases max mana by a moderate amount.

ars_nouveau:amulet_of_mana_regen.t: Increases mana regeneration by a moderate amount.

ars_nouveau:belt_of_levitation.t: A belt that allows the user levitate a moderate distance above the ground. Useful for climbing mountains! Simply sneak in the air while falling (or jumping) to rise.

ars_nouveau:belt_of_unstable_gifts.t: Occasionally grants a random positive potion effect for a short duration. These effects can vary in strength.

ars_nouveau:jump_ring.t: Allows the user to continue jumping in the air. Each jump will expend mana.

ars_nouveau:ring_of_lesser_discount.t: In addition to providing a small bonus to maximum mana and mana regen, Rings of Discount reduce the total cost to cast a spell.

ars_nouveau:spell_bow.t: A bow that can be inscribed with a spell using the Scribes Table. If the player has enough mana, arrows will become Spell Arrows and will apply the spell on their target. If no arrows are in the inventory, a spell arrow that deals 0 damage will be cast.

ars_nouveau:spell_crossbow.t: A crossbow that can be inscribed with a spell. The mana cost of the spell will be deducted when the bow is loaded if mana is present. Enchanter's Crossbows may use special augment arrows to empower their spells.

ars_nouveau:summon_focus.t: A special casting focus. Grants summons from spells additional duration, strength, speed, and deals damage to enemies that kill them. Additionally, casting spells that target you like Self and Orbit will cast a copy of the spell on your nearby summons.

enigmaticaddons:adventure_charm.t: Creation and destruction are the supreme power of the God, but sometimes it can be difficult to grasp the force well, and a slight mistake can easily lead to unnecessary destruction.

enigmaticaddons:chaos_elytra.t: Since the Heart of Abyss is in hand, why not set your gaze on the sky? Based on the same process as the Majestic Elytra, using more evil and powerful materials can obtain these stronger elytra.

enigmaticaddons:cursed_xp_scroll.t: When your period reaches a certain stage, experience may not be very useful except for being used for others, but now, through the power of curse, the nature of this scroll has undergone a huge change.

enigmaticaddons:forger_gem.t: Forging items is an inevitable step to strength enhancement, but before reach the perfection, there will always be concerns due to expensive costs or anvil breakage.

enigmaticaddons:hell_blade_charm.t: This charm seems to have been waiting for your arrival somewhere in nether, waiting for you to nurture it with your own blood. Anyone who notices the powerful power this charm gives, even if it honestly indicates the cost, will inevitably be tempted to wear it.

enigmaticaddons:quartz_ring.t: When you discover quartz in the nether, you surprised by its widespread distribution in the nether.

enigmaticaddons:scorched_charm.t: To purify the power of flames, in addition to protection, we also need more auxiliary abilities. Unlike Frost Walker, this charm allows you to walk directly on lava without the need to transform it into other strange objects, making it easier for you to travel in the Nether.

enigmaticaddons:thunder_scroll.t: Although the Will of Ocean can partly control the lightning, this is ultimately only indirect control and not fast enough. We use the divine power to write spells that resonate with lightning onto scrolls, using spellstone as the foundation and swords as the medium to release the power.

enigmaticaddons:bless_ring.t: When you are hesitating whether to sacrifice yourself to break free from the Seven Curse Ring, there is a brand new choice in front of you. The biggest problem is the Loss of Soul, and with the current materials and methods, it seems impossible.

enigmaticaddons:etherium_core.t: One is the Heart of Golem, which can be seen everywhere in the world, and the other is the extremely precious Etherium Armor.

enigmaticaddons:forgotten_ice.t: When it comes to Spellstones, names that represent flames, void, and so on will occupy people's minds, but in the distant snowy plains, there is still a force waiting for you to excavate.

enigmaticaddons:lost_engine.t: When you discover this spellstone, it still silently drives in the corner.

enigmaticaddons:disaster_sword.t: With a sturdy blade and a soul poised to take off, this sword showcases the skills of defense and counterattack. Holding this broadsword, you can use its wide blade to block almost all attacks.

enigmaticaddons:dragon_bow.t: Can Dragon Breath only be used for brewing? You may have thought about this issue. Recalling the ender dragon using its deadly dragon breath to burn your armor and skin, you also want others to experience it.

enigmaticaddons:evil_dagger.t: A mysterious weapon crafted from Nefarious Ingot, with endless evil thoughts gathered at the tip of the blade, greedily waiting for the soul to feast. As its name suggests, The Curse Carver is able to imprint a unique curse on your soul.

enigmaticdelicacy:hungry_charm.t: The idea of using food to make charms first appeared in my mind. Let's give it a try. But the result was somewhat unexpected.

enigmaticdelicacy:weapon_charm.t: Different weapons have different combat style, and there should be different ways to strengthen them according to different situations. This shining charm cast from multiple sharp weapons, which will give you different strengthening methods based on your main weapon.

goety:black_iron_boots.t: Cursed Metal Ingots seems to have the same properties as regular Iron Ingots, making it redundant to make an armor set based on it. However, with some tinkering, the ingots can be used to upgrade the regular Iron Armor to something better.

goety:blade_of_ender.t: Inspired by your foe, you've crafted a blade using the powers of the void and added some Dark Alloy to grant it the ability to self-repair with Soul Energy.

goety:bonehead_hammer.t: Fashioned in the likeness of a skull, this hammer pull nearby creatures towards the target of impact when swung at full power. It can perform the same functionalities as it's mundane counterpart. The hammer can be repaired on an anvil with a Cursed Metal Ingot.

goety:dark_chestplate.t: While Dark Alloy can be used to craft regular tools, when it comes to armor, it seems to require more... elaborate ways of crafting them.

goety:dark_helmet.t: While Dark Alloy can be used to craft regular tools, when it comes to armor, it seems to require more... elaborate ways of crafting them.

goety:dark_leggings.t: While Dark Alloy can be used to craft regular tools, when it comes to armor, it seems to require more... elaborate ways of crafting them.

goety:fanged_dagger.t: The Fanged Dagger might not seem impressive, but provides high attack speed compared to Swords and poisons targets. When a creature is killed, the bearer gains more Soul Energy than before. The dagger can be repaired on an anvil with a Cursed Metal Ingot.

goety:great_hammer.t: Blacksmiths and soldiers alike use the Great Hammer for its strength in forging and in battle.

goety:hungry_dagger.t: A version of the Fanged Dagger that, while no longer venomous, will heal the wielder 5% of damage dealt by it. The lifesteal percentage increases with each Soul Eater enchantment level.

goety:hunters_bow.t: A Bow suited to killing game, any animal slain by an arrow shot from this bow will drop more loot than even a Looting III weapon. The bow can be repaired on an anvil when combined with any bow.

goety:diamond_ice_axe.t: These pickaxe looking axes are useful at collecting ice and pushing you up over obstacles, though they lack the shield-disabling and wood-stripping abilities of true axes.

goety:reinforced_ice_axe.t: These pickaxe looking axes are useful at collecting ice and pushing you up over obstacles, though they lack the shield-disabling and wood-stripping abilities of true axes.

goety:iron_ice_axe.t: These pickaxe looking axes are useful at collecting ice and pushing you up over obstacles, though they lack the shield-disabling and wood-stripping abilities of true axes.

goety:rampaging_axe.t: An axe that hungers for both Blood and Wood. When killing a creature or chopping down wood, the user becomes slightly stronger and their hands move quicker for 10 seconds. Continuous killings/choppings amplifies the effect.

goety:stormlander.t: The Stormlander, enchanted with the power of the raging storm, is a treasure of the Illagers. It can perform the same functionalities as it's mundane counterpart. The hammer can be repaired on an anvil with a Pale Steel Ingot.

goety:abyss_crown.t: The Abyss Robes allows you to harness the power of the oceans far more efficiently and effectively. The Robes makes the wearer swim faster, and reduces the damage from drowning, even providing a small amount of air after taking damage.

goety:abyss_robe.t: The Abyss Robes allows you to harness the power of the oceans far more efficiently and effectively. The Robes makes the wearer swim faster, and reduces the damage from drowning, even providing a small amount of air after taking damage.

goety:alarming_charm.t: When hunting you down, the Illagers tend to signal their approach by having rows of fangs below you, or a Tormentor charging at you. With how sneaky they are, you've managed to devise a charm that would signal their arrival towards you.

goety:dark_robe.t: Evokers wear such snazzy robes, that you wonder if they're just for show or there's something special about them. By utilizing Dark and Magic Fabrics, you've managed to not only replicate their Robes, but also make some new additions, and discover they hold some special properties.

goety:feline_amulet.t: The amulet contains the essence of a feline creature on it, making it seemed like the wearer has one on them the whole time, warding off Creepers and Phantoms away.

goety:frost_robe.t: The Frost Robes imbues the wearer the power of all that's cold. Wearers will never freeze, be resistant to Freezing attacks and can move through Powdered Snow freely. The Robes also makes Frost Spells cheaper.

goety:frost_robe_cryo.t: The Frost Robes imbues the wearer the power of all that's cold. Wearers will never freeze, be resistant to Freezing attacks and can move through Powdered Snow freely. The Robes also makes Frost Spells cheaper.

goety:frost_crown.t: The Frost Robes imbues the wearer the power of all that's cold. Wearers will never freeze, be resistant to Freezing attacks and can move through Powdered Snow freely. The Robes also makes Frost Spells cheaper.

goety:amethyst_necklace.t: With pelts and some magical fabrics, this simple shamanistic robe reduces the soul cost of Geomantic spells by half. Amethysts are powerful conduits to Geomantic magic. By crafting and wearing this necklace, the casting time of Geomantic spells will be reduced by half.

goety:geo_robe.t: With pelts and some magical fabrics, this simple shamanistic robe reduces the soul cost of Geomantic spells by half. Amethysts are powerful conduits to Geomantic magic. By crafting and wearing this necklace, the casting time of Geomantic spells will be reduced by half.

goety:grave_glove.t: Scythes are fun and all, but they're very slow to wield making it hard for them to be a viable weapon. Using the remnants of the dead and Necroturgy, you've managed to create gloves that allow you to wield the Scythes more efficiently, increasing the attack speed by 50%.

goety:illusion_robe_mirror.t: Using the Occult Fabrics, you are able to create a set of Illusive Robes that will make you immune to Blindness effect and turn invisible when you do, making you highly undetectable to mobs and others of your kind.

goety:illusion_robe.t: Using the Occult Fabrics, you are able to create a set of Illusive Robes that will make you immune to Blindness effect and turn invisible when you do, making you highly undetectable to mobs and others of your kind.

goety:nameless_crown.t: After discovering the most hidden of necromantic ways, you've devised a new set of garb to showcase your mastery over the dark arts. The set functions the same as the old Necro Set with some improvements and does not give the wearer debuffs when under sunlight.

goety:nameless_cape.t: After discovering the most hidden of necromantic ways, you've devised a new set of garb to showcase your mastery over the dark arts. The set functions the same as the old Necro Set with some improvements and does not give the wearer debuffs when under sunlight.

goety:necro_cape.t: The scroll contains some instruction on granting, or calling forth, intelligence to the long diseased, allowing you to create and command undead Necromancers from Skeletons. The Necromancers can be taught to summon more than just Zombies.

goety:necro_crown.t: The power of commanding Zombies and Skeletons sounds wonderful, but with the power of the Necro Cape, your Necroturgic abilities enhance even further. Wearing it causes your Skeletons' arrows to pass through allied creatures, and Zombies can turn wild Zombies into more Servants that obeys you.

goety:nether_robe_warped.t: With the growing knowledge of the Nether, you've managed to craft a robe that imbues the wearer with its flames. Wearers will be resistant to fire attacks and extinguish fire from them more quickly.

goety:nether_robe.t: With the growing knowledge of the Nether, you've managed to craft a robe that imbues the wearer with its flames. Wearers will be resistant to fire attacks and extinguish fire from them more quickly.

goety:nether_crown.t: With the growing knowledge of the Nether, you've managed to craft a robe that imbues the wearer with its flames. Wearers will be resistant to fire attacks and extinguish fire from them more quickly.

goety:ominous_charm.t: When killing a Patrol Captain, you'll always get cursed with Bad Omen, which can be useful at times, but annoying and detrimental as well.

goety:pendant_of_hunger.t: The Pendant of Hunger absorbs any Rotten Flesh in your inventory, storing them within itself and uses it to automatically feed you once you are feeling a bit peckish. Of course, eating such food leaves you more hungry than before.

goety:ring_of_the_dragon.t: The Ring of the Dragon, when worn, powers up the breath spells, Fire and Frost, that not only increases their damage, but also affects the terrain itself!

goety:ring_of_the_forge.t: When summoning a Zombie or Skeleton Servants, they have a small chance of coming equipped with their own armor. With this ring, the chance will increase to 100%. If 'illagerServantTrainArmor' is enabled, wearing this ring will cause newly trained Illagers to gain armor.

goety:ring_of_thirst.t: The Eerie Pickaxe might be useful for collecting Experience Orbs, there are times where even that ability is not enough. With this ring, experience is immediately given to the wearer if it's dropped by killing a creature, personally or through a servant.

goety:ring_of_want.t: The Ring of Want allows creatures to drop more loot when slain by your spells or by creatures conjured up by you. For the Ring to work, you must enchant it, where it will accept the Wanting Enchantment which functions similar to Looting.

goety:sea_amulet.t: The Sea Amulet provides the effect Conduit Power towards the wearer whenever they're underwater, using up its inner charges. In order to charge the amulet, the wearer must be 8 blocks near an active Conduit underwater.

goety:spiteful_belt.t: You have crafted a Belt that specializes in hurting your attackers when taking damage. While it does not wear down like what Thorn Enchantment does to armor, it does use the wearer's Soul Energy when doing this. It can be enchanted with Thorns to increase damage.

goety:star_amulet.t: The Soul Shield Amulet mimics the Wither's shield when its power has ebbed. Should its wearer be half or less of their maximum health, arrows will bounced off them. Should one be capable of Creative Flight without being in Creative, they will find themselves grounded when the shield is up.

goety:storm_crown.t: A variant of the Wind Robes that takes the very lightning in its fabrics. Much like the Wind Robes, the robes allows you to fall slowly. Wearing the Robes also halves the Soul Cost for Storm Spells, but not Wind Spells unfortunately.

goety:storm_robe.t: A variant of the Wind Robes that takes the very lightning in its fabrics. Much like the Wind Robes, the robes allows you to fall slowly. Wearing the Robes also halves the Soul Cost for Storm Spells, but not Wind Spells unfortunately.

goety:targeting_monocle.t: Trying to hit your foes with your spells can be an ordeal as they could avoid your Magical Fangs with but a single step. With this monocle, you can lock onto nearby foes by pressing the 'Activate Curio' key, allowing you to more accurately hit them with a spell.

goety:thrash_glove.t: Hammers are quite heavy for a dark wizard such as yourself. Fortunately, with your crafting and forging expertise, you've discovered a way to create a pair of gloves that helps you to wield Hammers more efficiently, increasing the attack speed by 50%.

goety:unholy_hat.t: Using the purest blood of the dark emissary, which can only be obtained by slaying them within the Nether, you've made replica of their garments. The Robes gives you immunity to fire and Burn Hexes, and both robe and hat empowers some spells with hellfire.

goety:unholy_hat_halo.t: Using the purest blood of the dark emissary, which can only be obtained by slaying them within the Nether, you've made replica of their garments. The Robes gives you immunity to fire and Burn Hexes, and both robe and hat empowers some spells with hellfire.

goety:void_crown.t: The Void Robes imbues the wearer the power of the End. Wearers will have the chance of dodge attacks through teleportation, be immune to Void Touched and can move through Void Blocks freely. The Robes also makes Void Spells cheaper.

goety:void_robe.t: The Void Robes imbues the wearer the power of the End. Wearers will have the chance of dodge attacks through teleportation, be immune to Void Touched and can move through Void Blocks freely. The Robes also makes Void Spells cheaper.

goety:wayfarers_belt.t: The Wayfarer's Belt allows the wearer to not only move a bit faster, but also allows them to walk up a single block without jumping. The Belt also increases the jump height of the wearer and halves damage caused by falling off high places.

goety:wild_robe.t: The Wild Robes allows you to harness the power of nature far more efficiently and effectively. Servants that spews poison, for instance, will instead give Acid Venom, which affects even the Undead. Consequently, the Robes also provides immunity to poison and said venom!

goety:wind_crown.t: The Wind Robes allows you to fall slowly(or not so slowly when holding shift) and make you immune to fall damage. However, every second the robes slow your fall, Soul Energy is consumed. Wearing the Robes also halves the Soul Cost for Wind Spells.

goety:witch_robe.t: Witches are known to look snazzy with their massive hats. You've figured out how to make your own Witch hat with some Dark Fabrics and you've discovered how wearing them gives you a small chance of not consuming any potion.

goety:totem_of_souls.t: With your primitive Totem in hand, you've discovered that you can use it to craft brand new items that can be used to create all kinds of magical contraptions and focus! Though surely there's a more cheaper way of getting these items...

goety:crone_hat.t: Older and wiser, yet still malicious, Witches that have created and utilize far greater brews than their lesser kin. Their Hats are said to help make extra witch brews. Deals damage when getting hit.

cataclysm:ancient_spear.t: Through a simple Koboleton, you've managed to call forth a great Wadjet and have it serve under your thumb. The undead spellcaster can be healed by feeding it bones, and can passively heal if their owner dons a Necro Cape.

cataclysm:monstrous_helm.t: While the Redstone Monstrosity is one of the most powerful servants you can field, perhaps, with the power of the Infernal Forge, you'll be able to replicate its Netherite counterpart. Right click the center Reinforced Redstone Block with an Infernal Forge.

goetydelight:dark_knife.t: An upgraded version of the Cursed Metal Blade, inherently equipped with Soul Mending. Attacks inflict 5s of Corrosion effect, with all damage dealt multiplied by 1.5x.

industrialforegoing:meat_feeder.t: When in your inventory the Meat Feeder will feed you with the liquid meat stored inside of the tool.

simplymore:matterbane.t: Item Added In Simply More Created in mass to kill a rogue parasite, this weapon was given to as many people in their secret society as possible.

simplymore:serpentine_valour.t: Item Added In Simply More Serpentine Valour is a weapon that feeds off the triumph of its wielder, growing ever stronger. It was stolen many times by warriors bloodthirsty for its raw power. This weapon creates a slick substance upon its blade, delivering a stinging pain when touched.

simplymore:the_blood_harvester.t: Item Added In Simply More This blade once had a formidable place in a vicious Berserker's arsenal before it was abandoned, having fulfilled its use.

simplymore:tidebreaker.t: Item Added In Simply More When the Drowned God fell into the deep for the last time, he left this artefact behind to remember his legacy. Being remotely close to this unique causes hallucinations and paranoia, and wielding it can cause mindbreaking levels of insanity.

simplymore:iron_backhand_blade.t: Item Added In Simply More A slick blade designed to be held secretively behind you, consealing the blade before it is too late to react to your strike. Commonly used by assassins, backhand blades boast a very fast, precise swing.

simplymore:iron_dagger.t: Item Added In Simply More Daggers are usually regarded as unsophisticated weaponry, used by the most incompetent of warriors. It is hard to dispute the fact, however, that those who face the wrath of the mighty dagger do not usually last long enough to think of that fact.

simplymore:iron_khopesh.t: Item Added In Simply More A common weapon in ancient egypt, the khopesh can be found in graves of Pharohs long past. Khopeshs were usually used for vanity as well as warfare, a display of wealth and prosperity.

simplymore:iron_lance.t: Item Added In Simply More Commonly used in the olden era, it was said lances were used to pierce and pull people along the ground as the wielder ran around on horseback. While weilded without a secondary armament in the other hand and while on a mount, lances gain a boost in damage.
